text:
```yaml
name: cdk-source-connector-compatibility-test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'tooling/cdk/*'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-*'

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run compatibility tests for source connectors
        run: |
          pytest -m "not destination"
```
